benchmark.profile_identity: reconstructed public-figure SFHo-18.8, t_pb=1 s; not raw Garching data

equation_conventions.compton: B.14--B.17; B.17 uses one negative-muon species; mu-plus is reported separately as a diagnostic
equation_conventions.compton_mode_split: B.14 no-recoil Thomson-limit inverse-cross-section weights: w_L=(m_V^2/omega^2)/(2+m_V^2/omega^2), w_+=w_-=1/(2+m_V^2/omega^2)
equation_conventions.detailed_balance: B.10/B.19 and reduced absorption B.4 checked per mode and after summation
equation_conventions.escape: Local rates only; no P_escape is integrated here. Global escape is handled separately by audit_b16_escape_phase_space.py with the fixed-omega B.2 chord prescription.
equation_conventions.neutrino: B.6/B.10 direct two-body angular integral; L,+,- polarization modes sum to the scalar rate
equation_conventions.relativity: No full GR ray tracing is claimed; the local lapse is retained in the reconstructed profile and source measure.

limitations: The Compton split is the B.14 no-recoil Thomson-limit approximation, not a recoil-resolved three-mode kernel.
This is a local production/absorption package, not the global B.1/B.2 escape integral.
The SFHo-18.8 profile is reconstructed from public figures, not raw Garching simulation data.
title: 10 MeV local B.16 rate and polarization sample package
